steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 2 cm cubes.
Cut the chicken into 1 cm pieces, trimming any fat.
Warm the olive oil in a small pot over medium heat, about 30 seconds, until it shimmers.
Add the chicken and cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until no pink remains.
Add the sweet potato and the chicken broth. Cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes, until the sweet potato mashes easily with a fork.
Blend smooth for 6 months, or mash with a fork from 9 months. Loosen with a spoon of broth if too thick.
Cool to lukewarm before serving. Keeps 2 days in the fridge, or freeze in an ice-cube tray.
